title: G7 formal preflight accepted replacement case in the frozen public/private set
evidence: Before repair, replacing one formal case_id with a new ID and synchronizing its label hash and every plan row still passed strict formal preflight with complete public/label equality, family CF coverage, and pair/checkpoint coverage.
remediation: Freeze and enforce the exact audited 92-case corrected public set and add an adversarial replacement-case regression test.
